# Mastering App Control for Business

> A complete corporate reference for Microsoft App Control for Business (formerly Windows Defender Application Control, WDAC): an 8-part guide, deep-dive references for all 22 policy rule options and 12 file rule levels, and an advanced notes compendium. Authored by Anubhav Gain from source material by Patrick Seltmann (ctrlshiftenter.cloud) and Microsoft Learn.

> Agent entry point: start at [AI / MCP-ready index](/ai/) for a static discovery page, then use [resources.json](/ai/resources.json), [docs/index.md](/docs/index.md), and [sitemap.xml](/sitemap.xml).

Important notes:

- Every documentation page is plain Markdown with OKF v0.2 YAML frontmatter (`type`, `title`, `description`, `tags`, `status`, `generated`, `verified`, `sources`); the Markdown URLs below are directly fetchable.
- App Control for Business enforces application allowlisting in the Windows kernel via `ci.dll` (Code Integrity); rule evaluation order is: explicit deny, explicit allow (base), allow (supplemental), Managed Installer EA, ISG reputation, implicit deny.
- GitHub Pages cannot host a live MCP transport by itself; the static `/ai/` page and `/ai/resources.json` are the recommended agent-facing discovery layer for this repo.
- Generated assets for agents are available at `/ai/search-index.json`, `/ai/llms-full.txt`, `/ai/frontmatter/index.json`, `/ai/updates.json`, and `/ai/atom.xml`.
- Content is © 2026 Anubhav Gain, All Rights Reserved; see the [license](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/LICENSE) for reuse terms.

## Guide

- [Part 1: Introduction & Key Concepts](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/Part1-Introduction-KeyConcepts.md): Why application control matters, key concepts, licensing, and how App Control for Business compares to AppLocker.
- [Part 2: Policy Templates & Rule Options](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/Part2-Policy-Templates-Rule-Options.md): The built-in policy templates and the full set of policy rule options.
- [Part 3: Application ID Tagging Policies & Managed Installer](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/Part3-AppID-Tagging-Managed-Installer.md): AppID tagging policies and the managed installer feature.
- [Part 4: Starter Base Policy for Lightly Managed Devices](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/Part4-Starter-Base-Policy-Lightly-Managed.md): Building a starter base policy for lightly managed devices.
- [Part 5: Create a Base Policy for Fully Managed Devices](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/Part5-Base-Policy-Fully-Managed-Devices.md): Building a base policy for fully managed devices.
- [Part 6: Sign, Apply and Remove Signed Policies](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/Part6-Sign-Apply-Remove-Signed-Policies.md): Signing, applying, and removing signed App Control policies.
- [Part 7: Maintaining Policies with Azure DevOps (or PowerShell)](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/Part7-Maintaining-Policies-AzureDevOps-PowerShell.md): Maintaining App Control policies with Azure DevOps pipelines and PowerShell.
- [Part 8: AppLocker, Managed Installer (Option 13) & Selective MSI Allowlisting — End-to-End](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/Part8-AppLocker-Option13-Selective-MSI-Allowlisting.md): Using AppLocker alongside rule option 13 for selective MSI allowlisting.

## File Rule Levels

- [WDAC File Rule Level: FileName](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/file-rule-levels/Level-FileName.md): How the FileName file rule level works, its attack resistance, and when to use it.
- [WDAC File Rule Level: FilePath](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/file-rule-levels/Level-FilePath.md): How the FilePath file rule level works, its attack resistance, and when to use it.
- [WDAC File Rule Level: FilePublisher](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/file-rule-levels/Level-FilePublisher.md): How the FilePublisher file rule level works, its attack resistance, and when to use it.
- [WDAC File Rule Level: Hash](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/file-rule-levels/Level-Hash.md): How the Hash file rule level works, its attack resistance, and when to use it.
- [WDAC File Rule Level: LeafCertificate](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/file-rule-levels/Level-LeafCertificate.md): How the LeafCertificate file rule level works, its attack resistance, and when to use it.
- [WDAC File Rule Level: PcaCertificate](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/file-rule-levels/Level-PcaCertificate.md): How the PcaCertificate file rule level works, its attack resistance, and when to use it.
- [WDAC File Rule Level: Publisher](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/file-rule-levels/Level-Publisher.md): How the Publisher file rule level works, its attack resistance, and when to use it.
- [WDAC File Rule Level: RootCertificate](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/file-rule-levels/Level-RootCertificate.md): How the RootCertificate file rule level works, its attack resistance, and when to use it.
- [WDAC File Rule Level: SignedVersion](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/file-rule-levels/Level-SignedVersion.md): How the SignedVersion file rule level works, its attack resistance, and when to use it.
- [WDAC File Rule Level: WHQL](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/file-rule-levels/Level-WHQL.md): How the WHQL file rule level works, its attack resistance, and when to use it.
- [WDAC File Rule Level: WHQLFilePublisher](https://anubhavg-icpl.github.io/appControlBusiness/docs/file-rule-levels/Level-WHQLFilePublisher.md): How the WHQLFilePublisher file rule level works, its attack resistance, and when to use it.
